Maharashtra UCC Panel Sees Resignation Amid Officer's Induction

Former IAS officer, whose presence in a meeting was questioned by retired judge R.C. Chavan, has been inducted into the Maharashtra Uniform Civil Code (UCC) panel. Justice Chavan had resigned from the panel, with his departure reportedly linked to the presence of this former IAS officer. An email revealed the reasons behind Justice Chavan's sudden resignation.
